payload.title: Build deterministic typed canonical IR candidate for CC-WP-03
payload.work_clay: Build the smallest grammar-bound typed canonical IR layer above the current ClayCode BASE frontend without changing frozen language semantics or the active V17 grammar. Preserve generic, nested, union and optional type structure; declaration and field identity/order; unresolved external type names as explicit unresolved-preserved references; full syntax fallback for statements not yet structurally lowered; bind output identity to source, grammar and canonical-syntax provenance. Add deterministic mutation, duplicate-declaration/field and unresolved-type regressions. Local evidence is candidate-only until current-corpus and genuine Ubuntu receipts exist.
payload.reason_clay: CC-WP-03 remains an unclaimed critical-path package while WP-02 is being handled by another worker. Fresh MLIR primary documentation supports an open extensible typed IR with dialect-local types/interfaces rather than a closed hardcoded type universe; current ClayCode frozen semantics already define typed records, interfaces, capabilities and dialect contracts. The highest-value next move is implementation, not semantic redesign.
payload.leading_hypothesis: A deterministic source-order-preserving structural IR over the admitted parse tree can represent the current frozen G9 type surface without semantic changes and provide a stable substrate for WP-04 type/effect checking.
payload.strongest_counterhypothesis: The current V17 parse tree may omit or ambiguously encode type/declaration distinctions needed by WP-03, forcing either a parser repair or a narrower explicit UNKNOWN rather than invented type semantics.
payload.completion_clay: A branch/PR contains a deterministic typed-IR builder and focused regressions; generic/nested/union/optional structure is preserved; duplicate declaration/field collisions fail closed; unresolved external type names remain explicit rather than guessed; semantic type mutations change IR hash; repeated identical input is deterministic; real current G9+Dialect parsing/lowering is attempted; Ubuntu target execution remains required before CC-WP-03 PASS.
payload.executor_policy: ChatGPT owns only this isolated WP-03 typed-IR candidate lane. Do not edit V17 grammar or WP-02 canonicalizer. Re-read main before every durable write. No package PASS until production/current-corpus and Ubuntu receipts exist.
